stem: A design calls for one durable, ordered ingestion layer that a real-time fraud-scoring application and a separate archival pipeline both read independently, each at its own pace, without either consumer affecting the other's progress.

choices.text: Amazon Data Firehose as the shared ingestion layer
Amazon Kinesis Data Streams as the shared ingestion layer
An AWS Glue ETL job as the shared ingestion layer
Amazon QuickSight as the shared ingestion layer

rationale: Kinesis Data Streams retains an ordered, replayable stream that separate consumer applications can each read independently at their own pace, matching a fraud-scoring application and an archival pipeline reading the same ingested events without interfering with one another. Data Firehose only buffers and forwards records toward one configured destination; it does not offer multiple independent readers of a retained stream. A Glue ETL job transforms data that has already landed somewhere; it is not itself a durable ingestion layer that multiple consumers read from. QuickSight visualizes already-processed data in dashboards and plays no role in ingesting or streaming events.
